info.title: PlaybookControlPlaneService
info.description: On-prem administrative API for Playbook provisioning and policy.

post.description: Creates and provisions one Playbook. A deployment-configured per-tenant limit applies; the on-prem default is 128.

Registers a client-supplied RAM store reference and FAQ policy. Returns preparing and enabled=false. The control plane asynchronously provisions service-subject read grants and verifies live RAM access before ready; failed preparation becomes blocked. Poll GET until ready, then PATCH to enable.

patch.description: Updates FAQ policy or activation using expectedVersion. Supply job or enabled. Enabling requires ready status; pause is allowed while extraction is disabled. The deployment gate blocks policy updates and activation. Source identity is immutable; create a replacement binding to change stores. Stale revisions return conflict.

get.description: Returns tenant-scoped deployment-configured store suggestions, which may be empty. A client may submit another syntactically valid storeId. No RAM call or approval check occurs.

CreateExtractionBindingResponseContent.description: Durable tenant-owned metadata for one Playbook, one RAM store, and one FAQ policy. Ready requires verified service-subject access to the tenant-owned RAM store. Without a configured RAM connection, preparation becomes blocked. This release has no extraction worker. Activation requires a separate PATCH after readiness.

maxPreviewTokens.description: Optional estimated discovery-preview token ceiling. Missing or null on create disables budgeting; PATCH omission preserves the value and null clears it. Estimates use o200k_base over compact preview JSON plus fixed allowances, stored at authoring. The ceiling covers one logical discovery payload; model framing, session history and subsequent content loads are excluded.

ExtractionBindingSource.description: Typed RAM store reference. This release accepts only redis_agent_memory and a client-supplied storeId. The source is implicitly whole-store. When the deployment enables the RAM connection, server-side preparation verifies store access. Namespace selection and extraction workers arrive later; credentials are never accepted here. Unknown fields are rejected.

ExtractionConflictErrorResponseContent.description: Binding version/state conflict, or extraction disabled by deployment configuration. Disabled extraction still permits inspection, pause and deletion.

intervalSeconds.description: Read-only platform scan cadence, fixed at 300 seconds.

maxInputTokens.description: Source input budget per extraction operation, in o200k_base reference tokens over the serialized source-event array. Default 8192; allowed 256–8192. Retains a suffix of complete events. Excludes model instructions, output and consolidation input; not a provider billing-token guarantee.

ExtractionJobConfiguration.description: One extraction kind and its policy. Scan cadence is fixed at 300 seconds and is not accepted in requests. Omitted idle/maxInputTokens default to 1800/8192 on create and retain existing values on update. Idle bounds are 60–86400 seconds. Job type is immutable; changing extraction kind requires a new binding. Policy changes advance the binding version and do not reset completed-source deduplication.

ExtractionJobType.description: Exactly one extraction job kind. Skill extraction is reserved for future implementation and is currently rejected.

storeId.description: Optional deployment-configured suggestion; not an approval or verification of this store.
